input_schema.emit_preview: boolean - emit <basename>.preview.html sidecar next to the artifact for pptx|docx|xlsx
input_schema.enable_reference_scan: boolean (pptx only) - default true; false disables automatic recursive PPTX style scanning
input_schema.image_quality: deprecated; accepted for backward compat and ignored — PPT images always use the hosted image route
input_schema.prompt_template_id: server-managed image prompt template id (img only)
input_schema.reference_image: local path or http/https URL (img only)
input_schema.reference_images: array of paths or URLs (img only)
input_schema.reference_pptxs: array of explicit reference PPTX paths (pptx only)
input_schema.reference_root: directory root for recursive PPTX reference style scanning (pptx only)
